description: Source code implementing helper functions for mapping and TLV (Type-Length-Value) handling in an Open Source project related to network topology, including functions for managing bridging capabilities, neighbor TLVs, error codes, AP metrics, link metrics, channel preferences, transmit power, scan requests, VLAN settings, and traffic separation policies.

methods.name: map_get_bridging_cap_tlv
methods.description: Populates a TLV structure with bridging capabilities by querying current bridge list and interface info.

methods.name: map_free_bridging_cap_tlv
methods.description: Frees allocated memory within a bridging capability TLV structure.

methods.name: map_get_1905_neighbor_tlvs
methods.description: Generates a list of neighbor device TLVs based on topology data.

methods.name: map_free_1905_neighbor_tlv
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for neighbor device TLVs.

methods.name: map_get_error_code_tlv
methods.description: Creates an error code TLV with specified MAC address and reason code.

methods.name: map_get_ap_metrics_tlv
methods.description: Creates an AP metrics TLV from BSS info.

methods.name: map_get_receiver_link_metric_tlv
methods.description: Creates a receiver link metric TLV from neighbor link metrics.

methods.name: map_get_transmitter_link_metric_tlv
methods.description: Creates a transmitter link metric TLV from neighbor link metrics.

methods.name: map_fill_channel_preference_tlv
methods.description: Fills a channel preference TLV based on radio info and preference type.

methods.name: map_fill_transmit_power_tlv
methods.description: Fills a transmit power TLV based on radio info.

methods.name: map_fill_channel_scan_request_tlv
methods.description: Fills a channel scan request TLV with radio info, scan type, and channels.

methods.name: map_fill_default_8021q_settings_tlv
methods.description: Fills a default VLAN settings TLV from configuration.

methods.name: map_fill_traffic_separation_policy_tlv
methods.description: Fills a traffic separation policy TLV based on profile configurations.

methods.name: map_fill_empty_traffic_separation_policy_tlv
methods.description: Initializes an empty traffic separation policy TLV.
